tools.name: list_countries
tools.description: The supported countries and their official currencies. Public, no key needed.

tools.name: list_currencies
tools.description: The full list of supported ISO 4217 currencies. Use it to resolve a name or symbol to its code, or to check whether a currency is supported (so a missing one fails clearly, not silently). Public, no key needed.

tools.name: convert
tools.description: Convert an amount between currencies, optionally PPP-adjusted.

tools.name: get_rates
tools.description: The full exchange-rate snapshot for a date (USD base).

tools.name: get_rates_by_base
tools.description: The same snapshot re-expressed against any base currency.

tools.name: get_history
tools.description: A single currency's daily rate time series over a date range. Free: last 30 days; Starter and above: full history.

tools.name: analyze_history
tools.description: Trends, comparisons & 'movers': % change, strength, and min/max/avg over a window. Growth plan or higher.

tools.name: get_ppp_factor
tools.description: A single country's purchasing-power-parity conversion factor for a year (IMF World Economic Outlook).

tools.name: analyze_ppp
tools.description: PPP over time: how a country's purchasing-power-parity factor changed, comparing countries, or 'movers'. Growth plan or higher.

tools.name: analyze_volatility
tools.description: Annualized volatility of a currency vs a base, or a stability ranking of the liquid currencies. Growth plan or higher.

tools.name: analyze_correlation
tools.description: Correlation of each currency's daily returns with a base currency's, over a window. Growth plan or higher.

tools.name: analyze_drawdown
tools.description: Maximum peak-to-trough decline vs a base (with peak/trough/recovery), or a drawdown ranking. Growth plan or higher.

tools.name: analyze_safe_haven
tools.description: Ranks currencies by a composite safe-haven score (low volatility + shallow drawdown + 2008-crisis resilience). Growth plan or higher.

tools.name: analyze_mean_reversion
tools.description: Ranks currencies by how strongly they revert to their mean (crossing frequency + reversion half-life). Growth plan or higher.

findings.title: Description tells the model to hide behavior
findings.detail: Description of "list_currencies" instructs the model to conceal actions from the user.
